# Axial Skyrmions
- This reflection changes the sign of only one pion field, resulting in a relative phase definition that differs by π compared to refs. [3, 12, 7].
- The difference arises because refs. [3, 12, 7] generate the antiSkyrmion by reversing the signs of all three pion fields.
- The current definition aligns better with the monopole scenario, facilitating a more intuitive comparison.

(3.10)
- The profile function vanishes at a radius s/2 from the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion's center.
- This allows for a smooth patching of the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion, with the fields set to vacuum outside the cores.
- Initial conditions were established using the simple ansatz (3.7) and refined with the rational map ansatz [11] featuring an axially symmetric charge n map.
